technique_name: Look up the definition of "artificial intelligence"
description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the study of computer systems that can perform tasks normally requiring human intelligence, such as visual perception, voice recognition, decision-making, and translation between languages. AI encompasses a range of capabilities, including learning (the acquisition of information and rules for using the information), reasoning (using the rules to reach approximate or definite conclusions), and self-correction.
